concepts.learning_objective: Describe the cell cycle as interphase and M phase and state their relative durations.
Explain the events of G1, S and G2 phases and the change in DNA content and chromosome number.
Explain the quiescent stage (G0) and identify cells that enter it.
Identify the key events of prophase and metaphase of mitosis.
Identify the key events of anaphase and telophase of mitosis.
Distinguish cytokinesis in animal cells from that in plant cells.
Explain how a multinucleate syncytium arises when karyokinesis is not followed by cytokinesis.
State the roles of mitosis in growth, repair and continuous plant growth.
Explain why cell growth makes division necessary to restore the nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio.
Identify organisms and stages in which haploid cells divide by mitosis.
State the key features of meiosis as a reduction division.
Describe the events of leptotene, zygotene, pachytene, diplotene and diakinesis.
Describe metaphase I, anaphase I and telophase I and their outcome.

topics.title: Meiosis II and significance of meiosis

concepts.learning_objective: Describe interkinesis and the stages of meiosis II.
Distinguish the events of mitosis from those of meiosis.
Explain how meiosis conserves chromosome number and increases genetic variability.
